Buyers countersigned 08/12 evening. Settlement Period satisfied; no auto-termination risk.
Settlement Period satisfied by mutual signature 08/12 — cleared without reaching the deadline.

HIGHEST REMAINING SELLER RISK. Order via Fidelity Land Title: fresh Rocket Mortgage payoff good through 08/28+, plus payoff figures AND release commitments for all six judgment liens (bands in data/finance-context.md). Judgment-lien payoffs and releases are the slowest item in a Cincinnati closing file and are entirely on the seller side. [AT RISK as of 08/18: no confirmation logged that the orders were placed on 08/17 as planned. 2 days to the 08/20 target. Next step: call Jackie McGuire at Fidelity today and confirm all seven are in motion; if any of the six judgment creditors has not responded, ask title to escalate and identify the slowest.]

Zach reports buyers already have CLEAR TO CLOSE and likely an appraisal waiver (08/13, unconfirmed). ACTION: get written confirmation from Amy of (a) appraisal waived, (b) CTC issued + date, (c) lender has Addendum #2 and the $6,325 credit is on the Closing Disclosure.

ONLY remaining seller performance obligation: radon mitigation system installed (Velocity, ~$1,400-1,500; Jeff reported it lined up for the week of 08/17). Need installation receipt + warranty, and confirm whether buyers expect a POST-MITIGATION RETEST showing <4.0 pCi/L — the Defect Notice said 'mitigate if the level is at or over 4.0' and a retest is the normal proof.
Lender clear-to-close due (3 days before closing per contract 4(d)).

Buyer re-inspection 3 days prior to closing per Defect Notice. Scope is now RADON ONLY (all roof/gutter/chimney items were bought out by the $6,325 credit). Provide radon work order, warranty, receipt, proof of payment, and post-mitigation test result if obtained.
Buyer walk-through (within 48 hours prior to closing, contract section 11).
Closing at Fidelity Land Title; possession at closing. Verify wiring instructions BY PHONE with title company (wire-fraud warning, contract section 33).
